product: Metric view parameters are generally available
tagline: Parameters in metric views are now generally available.
what_it_does: Parameters in metric views are now generally available. Parameters bind values at query time, so a single metric view definition serves many query variants. Querying a metric view that defines parameters requires Databricks Runtime 18.2 or above.
plain_summary: Parameters in metric views are now generally available. Parameters bind values at query time, so a single metric view definition serves many query variants.
key_takeaway: Parameters in metric views are now generally available.
